baselineNote: Baseline is the pre-CI-refresh correctness branch. Main adds generated supported-value candidates and a resolved Test262 baseline, neither affecting measured operations.

build.locales: FormatJS default Chromium subset; magrinj shipping compiled data
build.magrinjBootstrap: Precompiled Hermes -O bytecode from pinned source
build.overlap: Identical precompiled Hermes -O bytecode on all hosts
build.rustOwnership: Original Box-owned ABI; no Rust record cache or Arc ownership changes

clock: __now when available; otherwise Date.now. Calibration >=50ms, median of seven samples.
order: Phase 1: three complete 29-case runs of baseline, cache-only, first-use trial, magrinj; round 2 reverses. Phase 2: three complete paired runs of cache-only versus bound WeakMap methods; round 2 reverses. No builds or profiling during timings. Final baseline/comparator medians come from phase 1; final after medians from phase 2.
outputChecks: 522 outputs checked across 18 complete runs. All FormatJS values match. Only comparator difference is known unsupported qzz locale en-US versus en.

cacheControls.diverse: 192 distinct valid en-x-bench-N tags exceed cache capacity 64
cacheControls.long: 20 private-use subtags, over 128 code units, bypass constructor cache
cacheControls.firstUseTrial: Same Rust payload optimization and Box ownership; only JS admission differs. Rejected: larger private records worsen long-tag latency.

conformance.locale: Rust/TS records; Hermes source and optimized bytecode parity; 334/336 Test262 with two existing Realm exclusions
conformance.collator: 69 exact fixtures pass independent ICU4C 78.1, ICU4J 78.1, ICU4X Collator 2.3.1 and SDK
conformance.consumer: All nine independent SDK API smoke scripts pass with their required data packs

sourceFormattingNote: Hooks changed ternary layout only. Shipping factory differs from measured factory only in whitespace.
